top_news.title: Anthropic: Can we predict the jobs robots will do?
top_news.dek: Anthropic study estimates robot task exposure and cost-competitiveness in the US labor market.
top_news.brief: What work can robots do? Anthropic's robot exposure index finds robots can do 3/4 of US physical job tasks, but are cost-competitive for only 0.3%.

top_news.title: Containers - New scheduling policy for Containers to configure image and instance from Durable Objects
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Containers now support a durable_object scheduling policy, allowing runtime selection of image and instance size.
top_news.brief: The new policy enables Durable Objects to dynamically choose container configurations rather than relying on static, centrally managed settings. Developers can define multiple named images in Wrangler to facilitate this runtime flexibility.

top_news.title: Expanding AI Storage Access with NVIDIA cuObject and the NVIDIA SCADA Server SDK
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduces cuObject and the SCADA Server SDK to accelerate data access for AI workloads.
top_news.brief: NVIDIA is expanding its storage ecosystem with cuObject and the SCADA Server SDK, designed to provide high-speed, RDMA-enabled access to file and object storage. By leveraging NIC and DPU acceleration, these tools aim to bypass traditional CPU bottlenecks, allowing compute accelerators to retrieve data directly from on-premises and cloud storage for training and inference.

top_news.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
top_news.dek: Deepseek and Huawei collaborate on open-source programming tools for Ascend AI chips.
top_news.brief: Deepseek has released open-source software, including the TileLang programming language, to simplify development on Huawei's Ascend AI chips. The initiative provides computation and data movement libraries, aiming to reduce reliance on Nvidia's CUDA ecosystem and improve performance optimization for domestic hardware in China.
top_news.image_alt: Huawei Ascend chip and software stack diagram

top_news.title: Launch HN: Magnitude (YC S25) – Self-optimizing inference engine for agents
top_news.dek: Magnitude launches an open-source, self-optimizing inference engine for agentic workflows.
top_news.brief: Magnitude is a new inference engine that compiles and tunes kernels directly on the user's hardware. It supports Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, and CPU environments, claiming up to 2x faster performance than llama.cpp by optimizing model execution for specific hardware configurations.

primary.title: AI Gateway - Pay for AI inference with Machine Payments
primary.summary: AI Gateway now supports Machine Payments in beta. With Machine Payments, clients can use the x402 protocol to pay for eligible inference requests directly from a stablecoin wallet instead of maintaining a prepaid credit balance. Machine Payments is available for the /ai/run endpoint with select open models. To request x402 payment, authenticate with a Cloudflare API token and include the Cloudflare-specific Payment-Method: x402 header: curl -iX POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run" \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \ --header
